release_notes: PWA upgrades, end to end. Chrome on Android and desktop now shows a rich store-like install sheet for every PWA landing: the manifest carries your screenshots and description (the builder's new Install readiness card shows live what will change — icon, description, screenshot sizes, push keys, domain), and existing landings pick it up without a re-save. Push campaigns finally show their money: a tap on a notification is counted as a push click on the click row and on the delivery, the Messages tab gets a Push-clicks column with CTR, and the funnel totals include push clicks. Messages can be targeted by country and browser language, carry a banner image (Android), and every notification has a localized Unsubscribe button backed by a public idempotent endpoint and a standalone unsubscribe page. The installed app now serves a localized offline page instead of a stale cached listing, in-app webviews (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook) get an 'open in your browser' card instead of a dead Install button, and Android Firefox/Opera users finally see menu instructions instead of Safari steps. Also fixed: /push_subscribe answered an empty 200 on router.php deployments.
